sections.Profile:
Magic Circle, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in June 1965, is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a fortune-telling and dancing theme. Designed by Ted Zale, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, six mushroom bumpers, and two slingshots.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Trains, Fortune Telling, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
